headerDisplay: The **SwitchBot** plugin allows you to control SwitchBot Devices. To get started link your SwitchBot account. 1. Download SwitchBot App on App Store or Google Play Store. 2. Register a SwitchBot account and log in into your account. 3. Generate an Open Token within the App. 4. Input your `Open Token` into the parameter below.
footerDisplay:
Please raise any issues on our [project page](https://github.com/OpenWonderLabs/homebridge-switchbot/issues).

If you would like to have other SwitchBot Devices added to this plugin fill out [Feature Request Form](https://github.com/OpenWonderLabs/homebridge-switchbot/issues/new?assignees=&labels=&template=feature_request.md).

[SwitchBot Website](https://www.switch-bot.com)

matterBatchRefreshRate.title: Matter Batch Refresh Interval (seconds)
matterBatchRefreshRate.description: Platform-level interval for batched Matter device status refreshes. Devices with a per-device refreshRate will use their own timer and be excluded from the batch.

matterBatchConcurrency.title: Matter Batch Concurrency
matterBatchConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel OpenAPI status calls during a batch refresh.

matterBatchEnabled.title: Enable Matter Batch Refresh

matterBatchJitter.title: Matter Batch Start Jitter (seconds)
matterBatchJitter.description: Random delay added before starting the platform-level batch timer to reduce synchronized spikes.

webhook.description: When enabled, all devices will use webhook by default (requires webhookURL). Individual devices can override this setting.

resetDailyApiCounter.title: Reset Daily API Counter
resetDailyApiCounter.description: Set to true to reset the daily API counter to zero. This is useful for testing purposes.

allowConfigOnlyDevices.title: Allow Config-only Devices
allowConfigOnlyDevices.description: If true, devices declared in options.devices that are not discovered by the SwitchBot OpenAPI will still be included (config-only devices). Default: false.

keepStaleAccessories.title: Keep Stale Accessories
keepStaleAccessories.description: If true, accessories that are no longer found via the SwitchBot OpenAPI will be kept in HomeKit. Default: false.

allowInvalidCharacters.title: Allow Invalid Characters
allowInvalidCharacters.description: If true, invalid characters will be allowed in the device name.

Allows for the override of the SwitchBot API webhook URL.
When enabled, all devices will use webhook by default (requires webhookURL). Individual devices can override this setting.
Allows for the override of the MQTT broker URL.

Specifies the maximum number of retry attempts for OpenAPI requests.
Specifies the delay, in seconds, between retry attempts for OpenAPI requests.

items.helpvalue: The following settings apply to all devices unless overridden at the device level.

items.description: Specifies the interval, in seconds, for retrieving the latest device status from the SwitchBot API when batching Matter requests.
Specifies the maximum number of Matter requests to process concurrently.
If true, enables batching of Matter requests to optimize performance. Default: false.
Specifies the maximum random jitter, in seconds, to add to the batch processing interval to prevent synchronization issues. Default: 0.
Specifies the interval, in seconds, for retrieving the latest device status from the SwitchBot API.
Specifies the interval, in seconds, at which devices will request updates from the SwitchBot API while in motion, for Curtain(s) and Blind Tilt(s) only.
Specifies the interval, in seconds, between pushes to the SwitchBot API.
Maximum OpenAPI requests per day. Default: 10000. When close to this limit, the plugin will pause background polling to avoid overage.
Requests reserved for user-initiated commands. When the remaining budget is below this, background polling/discovery pauses until reset. Default: 1000.
If true, completely stop background polling/discovery once the remaining budget hits the reserve. Webhooks and commands still work until the hard limit.
Specifies the logging level for the plugin. Default: info.
If true, devices declared in options.devices that are not discovered by the SwitchBot OpenAPI will still be included (config-only devices). Default: false.
If true, previously-registered accessories for devices that are no longer discovered or configured will be kept on the bridge. Default: false (stale accessories are removed automatically).
If true, the daily API request counter will reset at local midnight (system timezone). If false (default), it will reset at UTC midnight.
Resets the daily API request counter to zero. This is useful for testing or if you want to manually manage your API usage.
Allows device names with characters that are normally invalid in HomeKit. Use with caution, as this may lead to unexpected behavior.
